runs.text: A security company wishes to recruit an experienced person for a senior position to answer customers’ emergency calls, some of which would be during the night. It is offering a good salary and a small apartment next to the company premises.

runs.text: Why do female workers in many countries have a lower income than male workers?

runs.text: A bus company wishes to recruit a qualified senior manager to be responsible for coordinating bus timetables and managing staff. Some work will be required at night as the company also operates bus services at night. It is offering a good salary.

cells.text: a person employed as a manager of a small taxi company
